# Progress Details: 01-migrate-carpanet

## Changes
- Replaced FishyFlip with the direct CarpaNet 1.1.0 package reference and configured CarpaNet lexicon resolution for `app.bsky.feed.getPostThread` with referenced lexicons auto-resolved.
- Migrated `BlueSkyScraper` to `ATProtoClient.CreateWithSessionAsync`, generated `AppBskyFeedGetPostThreadAsync`, generated thread and embed union types, and exception-based client behavior.
- Kept the post record as `JsonElement` as generated by the thread response; extracted text and decoded facets through generated facet types. Facet replacement uses UTF-8 byte offsets and descending order to preserve correct positions for Unicode and multiple links.
- Preserved author, post URI, text/link substitution, image, video, and record-with-media handling.

## Issues and Resolutions
- The package assessment could not produce an old-to-new API diff because CarpaNet was not yet referenced; reviewed the official CarpaNet FishyFlip migration guide and inspected generated CarpaNet APIs during the build instead.
- The generated `ATProtoJsonContext` and `ATProtoCborContext` are namespaced under `CarpaNet.Json` and `CarpaNet.Cbor`; added those imports.
- The thread response's record is untyped `JsonElement`, so extracted text/facets directly and used the generated `Facet` model rather than expecting a generated feed-post record type.
